name: Wisp
tagline: A small light that knows your stuff: the face of a Raspberry Pi voice assistant.
facts: Six states: idle, listening, thinking, speaking, happy, sleepy
Runs fullscreen on a 5 inch 800x480 panel at 30 fps on a Raspberry Pi 5
Every state is a real seamless loop
Also runs on a 1.28 inch round display
Playable in a browser, running the real sprite sheets
